verdict.rationale: Dover documents posting a job to LinkedIn, Indeed, or ZipRecruiter from the job's Job Boards tab in a few clicks. Edits to the posting propagate to the careers page and any connected job boards, which covers the core fan-out from one posting. Missing for 10: any evidence of sponsored/paid post management (budgets, promotion) inside the ATS, broader aggregator coverage beyond the three named boards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: Open the **Job Boards** tab of a job and post to LinkedIn, Indeed, or ZipRecruiter in a few clicks.
Changes appear on your posting, your careers page, and on any job boards connected to Dover.
